sentences.l2: 在描述一组数据的集中趋势时，人们习惯把平均数、中位数与众数当作可靠的答案，然而它们各自的敏感性并不相同，一旦数据的分布形态发生扭曲，结论便可能失真。
sentences.l1: When describing the central tendency of a set of data, people are used to treating the mean, median, and mode as reliable answers, but their sensitivities are not the same, and once the distribution shape of the data is distorted, the conclusion may become misleading.

sentences.l2: 当少数极端值把整体拉高或拉低时，平均数会失去代表性：多数员工的月薪不过数千元，个别高管的巨额薪酬却使平均数看起来相当可观，此时中位数反而更接近真实处境。
sentences.l1: When a few extreme values pull the whole up or down, the mean loses its representativeness: most employees' monthly pay is only a few thousand yuan, but the huge compensation of a few executives makes the mean look quite considerable, and at this point the median is instead closer to the real situation.

sentences.l2: 众数的弱点在于，它只反映出现频率最高的那一档，若分布较为分散，它甚至无法说明数据的重心所在。
sentences.l1: The weakness of the mode is that it only reflects the one bracket with the highest frequency, and if the distribution is rather scattered, it cannot even indicate where the center of gravity of the data lies.

sentences.l2: 偏态分布尤其容易制造错觉——在右偏的工资、房价数据中，平均数总被长尾拽向高处，而中位数依然稳稳停在多数人的位置上。
sentences.l1: Skewed distributions are especially prone to creating illusions: in right-skewed wage and housing-price data, the mean is always dragged upward by the long tail, while the median still sits steadily at the position of most people.

sentences.l2: 因此，与其追问哪个指标最准确，不如先看清数据的形状，再结合三者的差异去判断，才不至于被单一的数字所误导。
sentences.l1: Therefore, rather than asking which indicator is most accurate, it is better to first see clearly the shape of the data and then judge by combining the differences among the three, so as not to be misled by a single number.
